import threading
import time


# 현재 상태 저장
original = pcb_select_filter_state()


steps = [
    ("Tracks", False),
    ("Tracks", True),

    ("Pads", False),
    ("Pads", True),

    ("Vias", False),
    ("Vias", True),

    ("All items", False),
    ("All items", True),
]


def change_filter(name, value):
    pcb_select_filter(name, value)


def restore_filter():
    for name, value in original.items():
        if name == "All items":
            continue

        pcb_select_filter(name, value)


def worker():
    # 시작 전 0.5초 대기
    time.sleep(0.5)

    for name, value in steps:

        # 실제 UI 변경은 KiCad GUI thread에서 실행
        wx.CallAfter(
            change_filter,
            name,
            value,
        )

        # 화면에서 상태를 볼 시간
        time.sleep(0.5)

    # 마지막 상태를 1초 보여준 뒤 복구
    time.sleep(1.0)

    wx.CallAfter(
        restore_filter
    )


thread = threading.Thread(
    target=worker,
    daemon=True,
)

thread.start()

print("Selection Filter visual test started")
